name: @rickylabs/harness-monorepo
description: Monorepo of DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin packages — the deterministic coordinator layer

scripts.build: pnpm run check:graph && pnpm run check:lifecycle && pnpm run check:links && pnpm run check:forms && pnpm run check:snapshots && pnpm -r run build && pnpm run check:publish && pnpm run check:docs && pnpm run check:skill
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run check:graph && pnpm run check:lifecycle && pnpm -r run typecheck
scripts.skill:install: pnpm --filter @rickylabs/forge run build && node packages/forge/dist/cli.js skill install --dispatch-label harness
